notes: Local demand (design §4; geographic supply, designer decision). A settlement sums the demand of every rule whose conditions all hold, plus the inputs of its services (service-roles.json `inputs`), within −3..3. Supply comes from the producers (producers.json), not from these rules. A price is base × 1.25^(demand − supply), with demand − supply kept within ±3 (about ½× to 2× the base price), before drift (±10%) and bulk pressure. Each rule's label is shown when the market explains a price, so rules are few, big and legible. Water is free and never traded. Designer calls 2026-11-13: arms are wanted where places are built to attack (settlement types with focus "attack": camps and forts), most when not under threat; armour where they are built to defend (focus "defence": cities, and the great walled towns), most under threat; timber most in villages, stone in towns and cities, metal in cities.

entries.label: Desert crossings
entries.notes: Waterskins, tents and pack frames for the caravans.

entries.label: Garrison
entries.notes: Soldiers to arm and feed: every camp, garrison and fort (settlement types with focus "attack").

entries.label: Mustering to march
entries.notes: Designer call 2026-11-13: places built to attack want arms most when nothing threatens them at home: they are projecting force. Under threat they dig in instead.

entries.label: Watch and walls
entries.notes: Designer call 2026-11-13: places built to defend (cities and capitals) want armour, most of all under threat.

entries.label: Manning the walls
entries.notes: The great walled towns defend like cities.

entries.label: Builders and workshops
entries.notes: Designer call 2026-11-13: cities build in stone and work metal (timber is wanted most in villages). Smiths and masons add their own demand (service inputs).

entries.label: Building in stone
entries.notes: Designer call 2026-11-13: towns want stone (halls, walls, bridges). Their smiths want metal through their own inputs.

entries.label: Barns and fences
entries.notes: Designer call 2026-11-13: villages build in wood.

entries.label: Raids
entries.notes: Raided places want armour and bandages; Unrest already wants arms.

entries.label: Sightseers
entries.notes: Sightseers come to stare, and need feeding.
